title: Research Forensics at Scale: An Auditable Multi-Evidence Framework for Scientific Integrity Screening
domain: metascience / research integrity / statistical forensics / scientific image forensics / citation analysis / NLP / scholarly communication
summary: An auditable multi-evidence research-forensics framework with six time-safe pre-outcome development FLAG evaluations across five papers, conservative non-escalation and abstention controls, four hashed no-known-integrity-concern development comparators, and a detector-output-blind 80-record confirmatory-feasibility frame spanning 2016–2025 correction/retraction strata. Confirmatory scoring remains locked pending issue/artifact adjudication, time-safe attrition and full protocol freeze.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided design with live prior-art and source-anatomy audits; benchmark protocol and evidence semantics frozen before confirmatory corpus construction
